checkedAlternates.risk: Type I uses flat metal blades.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Type I blades are angled in an inverted V-shape (group-4), unlike the parallel vertical blades of Types A and B (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Type L is used in Italy, a European Union country.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Type L has three in-line round pins (group-4), distinct from the two-pin Europlug/Schuko/French family (group-3).
